facts.summary: Positive early immunogenicity and safety data reported, no negative news · Phase 1 · CORAL samRNA vaccine in COVID-19 booster · not yet approved
facts.drug: CORAL samRNA vaccine (Spike plus T cell epitopes)

evidence.summary: Gritstone Announces Positive Clinical Results from First Cohort of a Phase 1 Study (CORAL-BOOST)
evidence.safety: CORAL’s samRNA vaccine was well-tolerated and demonstrated a favorable safety profile with no grade 3/4 adverse events or unexpected reactogenicity or safety events in ten healthy adults
evidence.program_discontinued: Gritstone is amending this trial to increase enrollment to 120 subjects and evaluate the addition of a second samRNA-Spike-TCE dose
